caption: The drawing features two ornate, plaque-like objects, one above the other, both with scalloped edges and an irregular, symmetrical shape. The top object is decorated with intricate, gold-colored patterns and reliefs, integrating stylized leaves and scrolls. Embedded in the design are multiple colored stones: several pink oval-shaped stones, two greenish-blue teardrop shapes, and a white circular stone at the center. There is also a curved arrangement of small white stones on the right side. Along the left and right edges, short black protruding pins or screws are visible. The bottom object is similar in shape and features a flat gold-colored surface with a black border. It contains a handwritten inscription in black ink that reads: "Presented to Mrs. E.M. Wills by the Citizens of San Francisco as a token of Gratitude for her Aid in honor of the Admission of California & Union Sept. 29th 1850." The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Brooch
